name: Noée Abita
bio:
Noée Abita (born in 1999 in Paris) is a French actress.

She began her film career in 2017 playing the lead role in Léa Mysius's film Ava, premiered during International Critics' Week at the Cannes Film Festival. Her performance earned her a pre-selection for the César Award for Most Promising Actress.

Subsequently, she continued to land roles in film and television. She notably appeared in Gilles Lellouche's Sink or Swim (Le Grand Bain, 2018), Philippe Lesage's Genesis (Genèse, 2018), and the mini-series An Island (Une île, 2019). Her portrayal of a young skier in Charlène Favier's Slalom (2020) earned her the Lumières Award for Best Female Revelation and a nomination for the César Award for Most Promising Actress. She continued her career in films such as The Passengers of the Night (Les Passagers de la nuit, 2022), Première Affaire (2023), and Jim's Story (Le Roman de Jim, 2024).
